en: Investigating mysterious ruins,\nhuh? Mera, this smells like a\nreal adventure!!
Looks like there'll be plenty of\nstrong enemies too. This\nshould be a fight worth having!
T'nique... was it? Let's have a\nman's duel to see who can\ntake down more enemies!
A... man's duel...?

You don't even know what a man's duel
is? A man's duel is a serious contest to
decide who is a man among men―a
true man!
A man among men... now that's\na challenge that gets me fired\nup!!

Right?! Back when I was in
Surferio, as the captain, I
spent every single day in man's
duels with my rival, Lucio!
The boys certainly have a lot\nof energy. What kind of\ncontests did you have?
Oh, you're curious too, sis?\nLet's see, for example...

Who could run around the village the
fastest, or who could hold their breath
the longest with their face in the
water...
Oh, so that's the kind of\ncontest it is...
(Huh, why did everyone\nsuddenly look so\nuninterested?!)
Uh, not that kind of contest...\nOh, I know!
We'd have a contest to see\nwho could sneak into a bandit\nhideout and steal the treasure!
Whoa, now that's a contest\nthat takes some guts!
(Yes! Mera's hooked!)
And did you win that contest,\nRoger?
You bet I did!
(Oh, right!)

When I sneaked into the hideout, I
messed up and ended up saving Fayt
and Cliff, who had been captured by
the bandits. That's how we all met!
Wait, so you're saying Roger\nbeat the bandits that Fayt and\nthe others lost to!?
Of course! Those two are\nsurprisingly clueless, so they'd\nbe totally lost without me.

Plus, those bandits were
nothing but a nuisance to the
people in the nearby towns, so
I gave 'em a good lesson!

The young chief of the Menodix, who
refines himself through masculine
competition... Hehe, this is shaping up
to be a great article.
Hehe. This is just normal stuff.\nIt's hardly worth writing an\narticle about.
Look, I'll keep protecting you\nfrom here on out, so just stay\nclose!
(Oh, come to think of it, didn't\nthey say memories get\nreplayed in these ruins...?)

Well, it's not like things would
be that convenient and replay
that specific time. It'll be fine,
it'll be fi...
Whoa!
Get me out of here already,\nyou guys! Come on, hurry up!
Who on earth are you?
Me? I'm Roger. Lord Roger! I'm\nthe captain, you know. I'm a big\ndeal!
That's not what I was asking.

Shut it, you big lug! When
someone's asking for help,
shouldn't you just let them out
already?

Honor and compassion are
important! My old man always
said so. This is totally Mera's
style!!
Hmm, this is...
It seems to be the exact\nopposite of what we were\ntold...

So, the plan is to tag along
with us and snag some
treasure if the opportunity
arises?
I'm telling you to just hand over\nthe treasure you've got!
Oh, this is it! This means I win.\nHehe, serves you right, Lucio!
I'm glad for you.
Yeah!
...This is all thanks to you, miss.
Hey! You're just gonna ignore\nus?
I might consider being grateful.
Might consider?
...I guess I wouldn't mind being\ngrateful.
I'll act like I'm grateful.
So, I'm grateful... and then I'm\nnot.
Good job. Thanks for the hard\nwork.
...Thank you very much.
There, that's more like it.
...Your actions are a far cry\nfrom being a "man among men,"\naren't they...?
Ugh... that was just youthful\nexuberance! Now I'm a\nperfectly respectable...
You were just lying to us now,\ntoo. About saving Fayt and the\nothers.
Th... that was just a figure of\nspeech, or maybe a difference\nin perspective...
You know what they say, all's\nwell that ends well...
I mean, I was fighting too, so\nit's half-true...
...I'm sorry. I lied.
Good. To be a real man, you\nhave to apologize properly.

But I totally get how Roger
feels about not wanting to lose
a man's duel... or any kind of
fight, for that matter!
Right? As the leader, I can't let\nmyself look pathetic by losing\nto a guy like Lucio!
Did you have a rival you didn't\nwant to lose to, T'nique?

I don't have one specific rival
like Roger does, but no matter
who I face in the Tatroi arena, I
refuse to lose!

I'm still trailing behind Lati, so
I'm definitely going to win this
time, thanks to the opportunity
Eve gave me!

The legendary Lycanthrope burning for
revenge. That sounds like another
great article. I'll set up an interview
right away, T'nique.
Huh, an interview with me?! I'm\nnot sure if I can do this well...

No need to be nervous. Just
answer honestly. For example,
T'nique, why did you start
seeking strength?
Why I seek strength... huh.\nHmm, I can't really think of a\nreason...

...I just wanted to be strong, so
I spent all my time training and
headed to the arena to test
my limits!
Wait...!
...I'm definitely going to win! You\ndon't have to worry about me.
Lyca: Really? Please do your\nbest, T'nique...
T'nique, what's going on?
This kid asked me to win the\ntournament at the arena, ssu.
Lyca: I've been hit by a really\npowerful curse...
Lyca: But if T'nique wins, I feel\nlike I can keep fighting without\ngiving up.
I see... T'nique, you've got to\nwin!
Just leave it to me! You're in\ngood hands, ssu!

Is this T'nique's memory!?
Promising to win the arena for
a suffering child... Mera, that's
so cool!!
No, this is... uh...
This looks like it could be a\ngreat story. I want to hear\nmore. So, what was the result?
Wa-wait a minute, ssu! I don't\nremember ever making a\npromise like that!!

Eh? Then is this something that's going
to happen? I've heard it's possible to
see events from a future that hasn't
happened yet.

But Lati-san has already returned to
her own time, so there's no way she
could be here at the Tatroi Arena with
me!
It's a fake T'nique!
Maybe you just forgot?
Could it be another world?
What, a fake me?!

True, T'nique is quite famous
at the arena, so it wouldn't be
surprising if an impostor
appeared.

Exactly! Lati is on friendly terms with
the kings of various nations, so
someone could pretend to be one of
Lati's companions to get close to
royalty and plot an assassination...!
Whaaaat! That's terrifying!!

That's not all! The plan is to
pin all the assassination
charges on T'nique and then
vanish into thin air!
Oh, Lati-san... Don't be fooled!\nThat person is a fake!!
Yes, let's head back right now\nand tell Lati about this!
...Hmm. Sorry to interrupt while\nyou're all fired up, but can I\nhave a word?
Roger, what is it?! We're in a\nhurry!
Isn't this a ruin where your own\nmemories are recreated?
Captain & T'nique & Chisato:\nAh...

...A-anyway, I don't know what
this T'nique actually is, but it
seems we have no choice but
to take things as they appear.
Y-yeah. I still have my doubts,\nthough...
Even I would remember such\nan important promise!
P-please don't look at me like\nthat. I'm telling the truth!

A kid that young traveled all the way to
the arena just to meet T'nique, and you
don't remember it? That's
disappointing.

The design of her clothes is a bit
different from the people around here,
so she might have come from quite far
away. It must have been such a
struggle...
I'm being framed! Please\nbelieve me!!

Now, jokes aside, I don't know what this
T'nique actually is, but it seems we
have no choice but to take things as
they appear.
Jokes?! You're all so mean...
Another world, you say?

...Right, Erys was summoned
from another world that Ioshua
and the others didn't know
about.

Wait, so is the one we're seeing
here a T'nique that T'nique
doesn't know? Mera's gonna be
so confused!

True. The mysteries of these
ruins only seem to deepen, but
for now, we just have to
accept things as they are.
Y-yeah. It's a strange feeling...
By the way, what's this "strong\ncurse" that boy has? He looks\nperfectly fine at a glance.
That's... the Lycanthrope's\ncurse.

In Roak, it's said that
Lycanthropes transform into
beasts because their
ancestors were cursed.

Normally, you can't tell someone's a
Lycanthrope when they're in human
form, but maybe we just clicked. I knew
the moment I saw him.
He looks like he's suffering\nterribly because of that curse...
...Because of the curse,\nLycanthropes are often\nshunned by other races.

That's why I've heard that
many Lycanthropes live their
lives hiding it. Some even wear
fake tails...
But since they transform just\nfrom getting nervous, it's not\neasy to keep it a secret...
What do you mean, "shunned"?!\nAnd "fake tails"?! Your race is\njust part of your individuality!
Don't act like that's just how\nthings are, T'nique!! Don't you\nthink that's crazy!

We Menodix are good with our
hands and make all sorts of
crafts. Then the March Rabbit
sell them in town.

Besides that, the Lum and Dragon are
great at hauling things, and the Foxtail
live long lives to pass knowledge down
to future generations.

We can survive because
different races cooperate. My
dad told me so. Mera, I'm right,
aren't I!
Your home has so many\ndifferent races, Roger. That's\nwonderful.
If anything, a country where\nonly one race lives feels\nunnatural to me.

...You're right. We of Nede
failed to acknowledge other
races and instead eliminated
them...

There must have been
conflicts we could have
avoided if we had just
respected one another more...
...Chisato! Now I have a reason\nto want to get stronger, and\nit's not just for the sake of it!
Huh? Where did that come\nfrom all of a sudden?

I want to give the Lycanthropes
courage by succeeding in the arena! I
want to show them that they don't
have to be swayed by words like
"curse"!
And I want everyone from\nother races to get to know the\nLycanthropes too!
The Felpool, Lesser Felpool,\nHighlander, Featherfolk, and\nLycanthropes in Roak...
I'll do it to help create a world\nwhere everyone can work\ntogether!
That's a great goal, Mera!
That's the spirit, T'nique!

By the way, I heard you're a
master of the Jingu-style fluid
arts, Chisato. What made you
start learning that?
Oh, so now I'm the one being\ninterviewed?
Yes! I'm really interested!\nPlease tell me all about it!

Well, it all started because of my
reporting. I decided that once I've
committed to a story, I don't want to
give up just because it's dangerous.
Oh...
Arnon: Looking is free, you\nknow. Feel free to browse!
Hmm. I wonder what I should\nget...
Claude C. Kenny. It seems he's\nthe leader of the hero's party\nfighting the Ten Sages.

They're planning to head to North City
to obtain the flying crest creature,
Psynard. I suppose they're just
preparing for that?

These kinds of everyday scenes are
important information for understanding
the hero's party. I've got to report this
thoroughly!
I wonder what brings the hero\nto a back alley like this?
Hm?
Ah! I've been spotted.
Huh? Who was that...?

This is a memory from when I
was secretly following Claude
and the others for a close-up
report.

You're like a ninja, sis! The way
you dove behind that cover
when you were spotted was so
cool, Mera!
That's thanks to my training in\nmartial arts. A reporter has to\nput in the legwork, after all.

As expected of the Hero's party.
They're breezing through the Crimson
Crystal Cave... Wait, if I lose focus,
they'll leave me behind!
Ouch!
If anyone saw me in such an\nembarrassing state...
Yikes, that looked like a painful\nfall...
Jeez! This ruin didn't have to\nrecreate such an embarrassing\nmoment!
Claude and the others were\nmoving so fast that I was\ndesperate just to keep up...
Yes, I was following Claude and\nthe others all by myself.

You mean Chisato was chasing after
Claude and the others all by herself
through a cave where everyone else
was working together!?

Claude and the others took
care of all the strong enemies,
so it wasn't actually that
dangerous.

Besides, I was fully prepared for
self-defense. I had a stun gun and tear
gas in my right pocket, and a Fire Flare
in my left.
What kind of pocket can fit a\nFire Flare...
And that tear gas sounds more\nlike a weapon of war...
Look, even a business card\ncan be a weapon if you throw\nit hard enough.
Th-the business card... it stuck\nright into the rock...

Then in my bag, I had three days' worth
of preserved food and water, a sleeping
bag, a portable tent, a portable stove,
a flashlight, rain gear, a Swiss Army
knife, sunscreen, insect repellent, and...
Whoa, hold on a second! You're\ncarrying all that with you!?
Yes, that way I'm safe no\nmatter what happens.

Carrying all that in one hand
while fighting and chasing after
Claude and the others... that
sounds like great training...
Oh, I think there's more! The\nnext part is where it gets\nexciting! Watch closely!
Look out! We have to save\nPsynard!!

I can't believe Alcmene and her
group would attack a
weakened Psynard! Go get 'em,
Claude!
Grrrrr...!!

What?! A Hellhound over
here?! Honestly, I'm just trying
to get Claude and the others
on camera!!
Phew, that should do it. I\nwonder what happened to\nClaude and the others?
It's a child...

I see... Psynard didn't budge
even when Alcmene attacked
because she was protecting
her child...
Now, what will you do, Claude?\nTo tame a wild Psynard, you\nhave to fight it and win...

I can't do that. I can't tear a
mother away from her young,
nor can I defeat a wounded
Psynard.
Claude... You're right. That's\nwhat makes you a true hero.
Grrrr...!!
Again?! This is the best part,\nso be quiet for a second!
I don't care if people call me\nweak. I'm sorry, everyone...

That's not true. To be able to
make a decision like that even
in such a dire situation... you
really are something, Claude.
Gwoooooooooh!!
Jeez! Be quiet!
Gwooooooooon!!
Well, we have no more business\nhere. I guess we'll have to ask\nNaal to think of another way.
Wait a moment! Something's\nstrange. It's like it's trying to\ntell us something...
Are you offering to help us?

Claude's kindness must have
reached Psynard... Ugh... this is
just too emotional! I can't stop
the tears...
Grrr! Gwooooooh!!

I said be quiet! How can you
think of fighting during a scene
like this?! Now, sit properly and
watch with us!
Grr! Gu, kuuuun...
You've got it completely\ntamed...

Claude really is amazing, isn't
he? Right then and there, I
decided that I'd follow him
absolutely anywhere.
No, it wasn't Claude, it was\nyou, Chisato...
No, that doesn't even matter\nanymore!
Right, Captain, you too. I've\nmade up my mind...
Me too...!
What's wrong? Why did you\nthree suddenly get so\nserious...?
Captain & T'nique & Roger: ...!\nChisato! Big sis!
Captain & T'nique & Roger:\nPlease make us your disciples!!
What!?

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
